answer: A sybil-resistant economy builds each identity on a basalt foundation of non-negotiable collateral, burned on audit failure, so forging N clones costs N times the floor. Honest agents climb a summit of cumulative attestation, where each credential must be signed by established peers who proved their own ancestry. A public voyage log records every ascent hop, letting observers replay the trail and expose duplicate forks. Governance grants one vote per established agent, so a botnet summit gains zero leverage.
